_comment: Nathan's way. Keys are flat dotted catalogue paths (SettingsJson_Path), deliberately not nested, so 'does this preset name only catalogue paths' is a one-line test. Only keys whose value differs from the shipped default appear here — a preset that restates a default is a default that can never move. pulse.unchangedFor is false, the one row here that is not the fork's shipped behaviour (ruling R26): the owner said on 2026-09-24 (ai-orchestrator-29 entry [100]) that his brother removed the 'unchanged N min' reading from the pulse, so quiet keeps it off while the shipped default brings it back.
